item.title: Trump downplays Moscow visit by CIA director as ‘semi-routine’
item.description:
CIA director John Ratcliffe is visiting Moscow on Tuesday for talks with Russian officials, two U.S. officials said. Why it matters: This is Ratcliffe's first trip to Moscow since he took office and the highest-level visit by a Trump administration official to Russia since January. Ahead of Ratcliffe's trip, the U.S. told Ukraine that a senior delegation was traveling to Moscow and asked it to suspend strikes until it leaves, according to a source with knowledge of the matter. Driving the news: Ratcliffe departed Washington on Sunday and traveled on a U.S. government plane to Latvia. On Tuesday, Ratcliffe travelled from Riga, Latvia to Moscow on a U.S. Air Force C-17 plane. The CIA did not respond to multiple requests for comment. CBS first reported on Ratcliffe's trip.

Covered by 1 corporate, 1 nonprofit, 2 public.
Sources: Axios, BBC News, France 24, The Guardian

item.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
item.description:

item.title: German airport workers die from malaria caught from plane-riding mosquito
item.description:
An unusual cluster of malaria cases at Frankfurt Airport infected six employees, two fatally. Mosquitos brought in on an aircraft are thought to have caused the infections.

item.title: Why Trump’s plan to rescind the Roadless Rule protecting national forests will struggle in court
item.description:
Roadless areas in Alaska contain important old-growth forests. Mike Reid Photography/Moment via Getty Images Over 368,000 miles of roads wind through U.S. national forests, eight times more than the entire interstate highway system . Many are heavily eroded and prone to landslides, and driving vehicles on them can spread invasive species. They need billions of dollars in repairs. Yet the Trump administration wants to build more roads in America’s national forests to expand timber production, specifically in untouched areas currently protected by the 2001 federal Roadless Rule . In announcing the administration’s formal proposal to rescind the Roadless Area Conservation Rule on Aug. 18, 2026, Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins argued that building roads in these areas is important for fighting wildfires. However, data show that roads actually tend to increase the risk of fires…

Sources: Mother Jones, The Conversation, The Guardian

item.title: $17B Meta settlement puts focus on youth mental health crisis, Colorado AG says
item.description:
Paid employment can boost confidence and wellbeing, says Pat McFadden as jobs guarantee scheme gets under way Work must be “part of the answer” to the mental health crisis among young people, the work and pensions secretary, Pat McFadden, has said as he met some of the first beneficiaries of Labour’s youth jobs guarantee scheme . He was speaking on a visit to Boots’s headquarters in Nottingham on Wednesday, where several 18- to 21-year-olds were taken on under the job guarantee – with their wages paid by the taxpayer for six months.
